name: paraformer-v2
description: The latest Paraformer speech recognition model, supporting multilingual speech recognition across multiple languages. You can use the language_hints parameter to specify the target language and improve recognition accuracy. The model supports audio input at any sampling rate and covers languages including Chinese, including Cantonese and other dialects, English, Japanese, and Korean. Hotword customization is also supported.
zhDescription: 推荐使用 Paraformer最新语音识别模型，支持多个语种的语音识别。可以通过language_hints参数选择语种获得更准确的识别效果，支持任意采样率。 支持的语言包括：中文（含粤语等各种方言）、英文、日语、韩语。可支持热词。

agentIntegrations.name: Codex
agentIntegrations.description: Configure MaaS as an OpenAI-compatible model provider.
agentIntegrations.zhDescription: 将 MaaS 配置为 Codex 的 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商。

model = "paraformer-v2"

[model_providers.maas]
name = "MaaS"

env_key = "MAAS_API_KEY"
wire_api = "responses"
